# Third-party attribution

The supplied GAIL reference includes an MIT license naming **Hyungcheol Noh (2022)**. Its license text is preserved verbatim in [GAIL_LICENSE](GAIL_LICENSE) and in `reference/gail-baseline/LICENSE`.

The supplied reference README attributes the implementation to Hyungcheol Noh and links his reinforcement learning collection at https://github.com/hcnoh/rl-collection-pytorch. It also references the original GAIL paper by Jonathan Ho and Stefano Ermon, *Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning* (2016), https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.03476.

The coursework adaptation, experiment configuration, validation scripts, checkpoints, and report are presented with that origin acknowledged. No new blanket license is assigned to the report or to material whose licensing scope was not explicitly supplied.
